timeline.title: Animation
timeline.apngTitle: APNG: like GIF but without the palette limit (full RGBA color)
timeline.pngSequenceTitle: Exports each frame as a numbered PNG in a folder
timeline.webmTitle: Real WebM video (MediaRecorder) — takes as long as the animation lasts to export. MP4 isn't available: it would require bundling ffmpeg.wasm (~30MB).
timeline.spritesheetTitle: All frames in a single grid image

inbetween.hint: Generates transition frames (crossfade) between the current frame and the next one — an approximate guide, not a replacement for hand-drawn inbetweens.
inbetween.noNextFrameTitle: There's no next frame to interpolate with

comic.title: Comic / Manga
comic.selectionHint: Make a rectangular selection on the canvas to place panels, speed lines, or bubbles (page templates don't need one).

screentone.title: Screentones
screentone.hint: Applies to the selection, or to the whole layer if there isn't one.

speedLines.title: Speed lines
speedLines.hint: Radial: burst from the center of the selection. Parallel: horizontal stripes filling the selection.

grid.keepVpOnHorizon: Keep vanishing points on the horizon
grid.horizonHint: What's above the horizon is seen from below, and what's below it, from above. Drag the "Horizon" tab on the canvas or use the bar. In 1- and 2-point perspective, the vanishing points always stay on this line.
grid.dragHint: You can also drag the points directly on the canvas.
grid.presetsHint: Saved globally (not with the project) — reuse them in any drawing. Each point is saved as a proportion of the canvas, so it adapts to canvases of a different size.

guides.rulerHint: With the rulers visible, drag from them onto the canvas to create a new guide.
guides.snapHint: Applies when dragging shapes, transforming, and to guides — not to freehand brush/eraser strokes.

ruler.gridWarning: Turn on "Show perspective grid" in the Perspective tab: the ruler uses its vanishing points.
ruler.showOnCanvas: Show the ruler on the canvas
ruler.centerOnCanvas: Center the ruler on the canvas
ruler.footerHint: Works with the brush, eraser, and blur, and combines with symmetry. Each type is saved with the project.

symmetry.hint: While you paint, each brush/eraser stroke is repeated mirrored or rotated according to the chosen mode — it paints for real onto the layer, it's not just a preview.

sizesSection.title: Export the current project at several sizes
sizesSection.hint: Flattens the current canvas and exports it resized (with letterboxing) to each chosen size, in a single step.

batch.importDesktopOnlyToast: Importing images is only available in the desktop app

recording.title: Session recording
recording.replayButtonTitle: Plays back the process from the history steps, without recording anything
recording.replayButton: Play back the process step by step
recording.idleHint: Record your canvas while you draw, in real time, and then generate a sped-up timelapse or a clip to export as WebM.
recording.trimHint: Leave the fields empty to use the full recording.
